# Celtrino

> > Celtrino provides EDI managed services, Peppol e-invoicing solutions, and B2B integration for retail and public sector organizations across the UK and Ireland.

Celtrino specializes in electronic data interchange (EDI) and e-invoicing solutions, serving major retailers like Tesco, Aldi, ASDA, Lidl, and Sainsbury's. The company offers Peppol Connect access point services, Supply Chain Connect platform, and comprehensive EDI managed services using protocols including AS2, AS4, EDIFACT, and Tradacoms.

## Key Topics

- EDI (Electronic Data Interchange)
- Peppol e-invoicing
- EDI managed services
- Retail EDI integration
- E-invoicing compliance
- Trading partner integration
- AS2 and AS4 protocols
- Supply chain digitalization
- EDIFACT and Tradacoms standards
- Supplier onboarding
- Public sector e-procurement
- EU Directive 2014/55/EU
- Accounts payable automation
- B2B document exchange
- Supply Chain Connect platform

## Core EDI Solutions

- [EDI Services | EDI Managed Services | Celtrino](https://www.celtrino.com/solutions/edi-managed-services): EDI managed services with Azure, AS2/AS4 protocols & consulting support
- [EDI invoicing | EDI Ordering | Celtrino](https://www.celtrino.com/solutions/edi/edi-orders-invoices-with-customers): EDI invoicing/ordering with EDIFACT, Tradacoms & ANSI X12 standards
- [Tesco EDI​ | Celtrino](https://www.celtrino.com/edi-with-tesco): Tesco EDI integration with DESADV/INVOIC messages for UK suppliers
- [Supply Chain Connect - Celtrino](https://www.celtrino.com/supply-chain-connect): Supply Chain Connect platform for B2B document exchange & automation

## Peppol E-Invoicing

- [Electronic Invoicing Solutions | E Invoicing Solutions | Celtrino](https://www.celtrino.com/solutions/einvoicing): E-invoicing solutions with Peppol Connect, AS4 & EU directive compliance
- [Peppol Services​ | Peppol Service Provider | Celtrino](https://www.celtrino.com/solutions/peppol-connect): Peppol Connect access point services for e-procurement & invoicing
- [Public Sector Buyers - Celtrino](https://www.celtrino.com/public-sector-buyers): EU Directive 2014/55/EU e-invoicing compliance for Irish public sector
- [How does Peppol work​? | Celtrino](https://www.celtrino.com/how-peppol-can-work-for-your-business): Guide to Peppol electronic document exchange and B2B integration
- [How to Register for Peppol​? | Celtrino](https://www.celtrino.com/peppol-supplier-onboarding): Peppol registration guide for suppliers working with Aldi & ASDA
